source_text: These rituals, prevalent among communities such as the Xhosa in South Africa, Maasai in Kenya and Tanzania, and various groups in Zambia and Malawi, often involve non-medically trained practitioners using rudimentary tools in isolated settings, heightening risks of infection, excessive bleeding, and penile amputation.
